title: Support team profile switching
description: Provide real user authentication and switching among the four team roles; the current UI only simulates a selected profile.
acceptance_criteria: Authentication succeeds for valid team accounts; the active role persists across views and reloads; unauthenticated or unauthorized access is rejected.

title: Maintain project metadata
description: Allow authorized users to maintain the unique project key, name, and target dates and propagate changes to dashboard views.
acceptance_criteria: Project key, name, start date, and end date can be edited; invalid or duplicate keys and invalid date ranges are rejected; saved values appear consistently in project views.

title: Render five Kanban workflow columns
description: Render Backlog, To Do, In Progress, Code Review, and Done with task counts.
acceptance_criteria: All five named stages render; each column count matches the tasks shown in that stage.

title: Move cards with HTML5 drag and drop
description: Support card movement across workflow columns and record the transition; verify the SRS local update target of under 50 ms.
acceptance_criteria: A dropped card changes to the target stage; the state update is measured below 50 ms locally; an activity record contains actor, task, prior/next stage, and timestamp.

title: Advance task to the next stage
description: Provide one-click sequential stage advancement controls.
acceptance_criteria: One click advances a task exactly one stage; Done has no enabled advance action; the resulting state persists.

title: Create and update tasks
description: Allow users to create and edit tasks with title, description, and priority through a validated modal.
acceptance_criteria: Title and priority are validated; create and edit persist all supported task fields; reopening the task shows saved values.

title: Categorize tasks with labels and tags
description: Support task labels that are visible as distinct pills on task cards.
acceptance_criteria: Users can add and remove labels; saved labels render as distinct pills on the matching task card.

title: Enforce Fibonacci story point values
description: Restrict task estimates to the SRS scale: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, and 21.
acceptance_criteria: The estimate control offers only 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, and 21; invalid values are rejected when saving.

title: Calculate planned points and completion
description: Compute total planned points and sprint completion as Done Points divided by Total Points.
acceptance_criteria: Totals match the selected sprint tasks; completion uses Done Points / Total Points × 100; an empty sprint reports 0% without an error.

title: Manage sprint lifecycle
description: Support planned, active, and completed sprint states and scope task metrics to the selected active sprint.
acceptance_criteria: A sprint can move through planned, active, and completed states; active sprint selection scopes its task board and metrics; invalid state transitions are prevented or handled.

title: Plot actual and ideal burndown
description: Show daily remaining story points against the ideal linear burn trajectory for a sprint.
acceptance_criteria: Chart includes daily labels, an ideal line, and actual remaining points; actual values are derived from recorded daily progress rather than interpolation alone; empty and completed sprints render safely.

title: Show executive KPI dashboard
description: Display total points, delivered velocity, and progress that react to task changes.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard KPIs match current task data and update after a task mutation without a page reload.

title: Show team workload and capacity
description: Aggregate assigned points and completion rates for each team member.
acceptance_criteria: Each team member’s assigned points and completed points match their tasks; completion rate is correct and handles zero assigned points.

title: Maintain an immutable audit trail
description: Capture entity mutations with actor, action, target, and timestamp in an audit history.
acceptance_criteria: Task and sprint mutations create attributable timestamped audit records; existing records cannot be edited or removed through the application; history is not silently truncated.

title: Synchronize data with Supabase PostgreSQL
description: Synchronize relational project, sprint, and task data through Supabase when valid credentials are configured.
acceptance_criteria: Configured clients read and upsert project, sprint, and task records; synchronization errors are surfaced and do not discard local data; schema compatibility is documented.

title: Preserve offline CRUD fallback
description: Keep full create, read, update, and delete functionality in browser storage when cloud credentials are absent or cloud access is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Without credentials, CRUD works from local storage and survives reload; a failed cloud request falls back without losing the local change.

title: Filter tasks by multiple attributes
description: Combine assignee, priority, and text query filters on the task board.
acceptance_criteria: Assignee, priority, and query filters can be combined; results satisfy every selected predicate; clearing filters restores all in-scope tasks.

title: Run CI on pushes and pull requests
description: Ensure GitHub Actions validates build, tests, and lint for push and pull request events.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow runs on push and pull request; build, tests, lint, and required security audit failures fail the check; results are visible on the commit or pull request.

title: Isolate data by role and membership
description: Enforce confidentiality by restricting project data to authorized roles and members.
acceptance_criteria: Unauthorized role or non-member requests cannot read or mutate protected project data; access rules are documented and covered by verification cases.

title: Protect audit record integrity
description: Prevent unverified alteration of audit history and preserve the integrity of logged events.
acceptance_criteria: Audit records are append-only for application roles; attempted unauthorized update/delete is rejected; integrity controls are documented and verified.

title: Attribute changes to verified actors
description: Ensure task and sprint mutations are attributed to authenticated student actors.
acceptance_criteria: Mutation records use the authenticated actor identity; changing the client-side profile cannot impersonate a different verified actor.

title: Enforce Supabase row-level security
description: Apply Row Level Security to every Supabase PostgreSQL table.
acceptance_criteria: RLS is enabled for every application table; policies restrict read/write by membership and role; policy checks are documented and verified.

title: Keep credentials out of source control
description: Do not hardcode credentials; manage them through environment configuration or client settings.
acceptance_criteria: Repository contains no committed secret keys; configuration accepts only expected values; setup guidance explains safe environment/client configuration and key rotation.

title: Require HTTPS and TLS for cloud traffic
description: Require HTTPS transport with TLS 1.3 for Supabase cloud data transmission.
acceptance_criteria: Cloud URLs must use HTTPS; the deployed connection negotiates TLS 1.3; insecure endpoints are rejected; transport requirements are documented and verified.

title: Sanitize textual input against XSS
description: Validate and safely handle textual input for task and project fields to prevent cross-site scripting.
acceptance_criteria: Malicious markup is not executed in task, project, label, or search views; inputs are validated and output remains safely rendered; regression cases cover common XSS payloads.

title: Block CI on dependency security findings
description: Run an automated npm dependency audit during CI and act on findings.
acceptance_criteria: CI runs npm audit at the agreed severity threshold; audit failures fail the workflow; remediation or documented exception is recorded for each blocking finding.

title: Meet local interaction performance target
description: Complete drag-and-drop state updates and UI rerenders in under 50 ms locally.
acceptance_criteria: A repeatable local performance check records the drag/drop state update and render below 50 ms on the documented test setup; regressions are caught by a verification procedure.

title: Maintain availability through offline fallback
description: Keep the system operational through offline fallback when cloud access is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: With no credentials and during simulated cloud failure, core task and sprint CRUD remains usable; local changes persist after reload.

title: Meet accessibility and usability target
description: Use high-contrast typography and accessible color palettes, targeting Lighthouse score above 90.
acceptance_criteria: Text and controls meet contrast requirements; keyboard and screen-reader checks cover primary workflows; Lighthouse accessibility score exceeds 90 on the documented route.

title: Preserve data across reloads and tab closures
description: Avoid data loss across browser reloads or tab closures.
acceptance_criteria: Saved project, sprint, task, and activity data remains after reload and tab closure; recovery behavior is documented and verified for local and configured modes.

title: Keep architecture maintainable and build clean
description: Maintain modular separation, zero ESLint warnings, and a passing production build.
acceptance_criteria: Service, context, and component boundaries remain clear; lint completes with zero warnings; production build passes in CI.
